hypothesis: Current detection scale and predicted track center can reduce association sensitivity to fish aspect changes; a fixed factorial separates this from removal of score fusion.
measured_scale_cost: At every primary/secondary/pending matching stage, use IoU between the candidate detection box and a box of that same measured width/height centered at the predicted track center. Existing matching thresholds remain0.9/0.5/0.7. Primary/pending score fusion follows the independent score factor.
unchanged: Original detector scores/boxes/order, high and low partition thresholds, births, measurement update equations, template reliability rules, trained encoders/heads/calibrations, current-shape output rendering and selected peripheral publication. Changed associations may change subsequent states, identities and memories.
selection: All three nonreference factorial cases are primary candidates. Require forward Train last-quarter HOTA gain>=0.1 over the selected PP method and full Dev HOTA no lower than PP within1e-10. Rank validation HOTA, then Dev HOTA/AssA/IDF1, then identifier. Freeze before any new Test evaluation; no Test promotion.
Test_if_qualified: All four preregistered factorial cases, complete Test7/15985; one selected method remains primary. Original RGB-only baseline29.528970687393972 is fixed.
modality_scope: Both changes are classical geometric association factors over the fixed pseudo-IR visual source, not new independent IR information or automatically novel multimodal contributions.
exposure: Historical Test and prior PP results were exposed before this hypothesis. Selection uses Train/Dev, with no new blind-test claim. Older work inspected the Train development window; encoders saw Train identities; the older RGB detector had Dev exposure.
